description: From \(\exists x\,A(x)\) and a proof of \(B\) under a temporary assumption \(A(c)\), infer \(B\) and discharge that assumption, provided \(c\) appears neither in the other open assumptions, nor in \(A(x)\), nor in \(B\).
signature:

  (hEx : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Proof L Γ φ.ex)
  (hB :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Proof L
      (insert φ.toFormula (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.liftContext Γ))
      (FirstOrder.Language.Formula.relabel Sum.inl C)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Proof L Γ C
